name: Russian Kalette
source:
Rance's new servant.
Slave traders once confined her along with many others.
Rance saves her from being sold, but he demands sexual intercourse from the imprisoned girls in exchange for their freedom. Russian begs Rance to spare the frightened minors and promises to do anything he wants.

Rance accepted the plea with one condition: "For the duration of my current adventure, you will become my slave." Russian agreed and attended to Rance's personal needs throughout the journey.

[Translated and edited from the official site]
